### Lot and His Daughters
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lot-and-his-daughters
Passage: Genesis 19:30-36
Points:
- Lot's previous worldly choices led to severe decline, leaving him impoverished and hiding in a cave out of fear.
- Panicking that they would never marry, Lot's daughters engaged in an incestuous scheme to preserve their father's line.
- Even though the family physically escaped Sodom, the corrupt moral influence of the city remained in their hearts.
- Lot lost his wealth, family integrity, and reputation, illustrating how worldly compromise invites divine discipline.
